GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward to lead 2 Lengths 600m lead 2 Lengths home turn 1st 2 Lengths tired final 100m # led/honest effort

jumped ok . Settled Down Two Wide 6th 4 Lengths @ 700m. in between runners into Straight but then out to Middle Of Track all cl. couldn't quicken Under Whip though (vetted - no issues) # couldn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated that his mount began only fairly however was able to work forward into a handy position. Rdr stated his mount sprinted fairly on straightening however felt to peak on its run near the 200m and weakened from this point. Rdr stated his mount was first up today, on heavy track conditions, and this may have told on its finishing effort. A post-race veterinary examination of the filly did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Approaching the home turn became held up on heels and was unable to improve until shifting out shortly after straightening.

Slow Out Quickly Recovered keen early & middle got head up 800 checked Lost Ground Just Off Pace 4l Made Some Ground Wide home turn 2 Lengths Middle Of Track didn't come on. r-slow out commenced to overrace detrimental to chances. # trouble/can forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages and got its head up on several occasions. Near the 800m was checked away from heels. Rider reported after being slow to begin, his mount commenced to overrace through the early and middle stages and didn't finish its race off as a result. Post race vets - no abs.
